Netanyahu calls UK 'Islamic Republic of Britain' in podcast

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu referred to the United Kingdom as "the Islamic Republic of Britain" during a podcast interview. The remark was made in the context of discussing nuclear weapons. The United Kingdom's government responded to the comment. Some coverage noted criticism of Netanyahu by a political rival for attacking an international ally and overseeing a "horrific diplomatic failure."
